best_for: Bedroom producers and students who want to make beats and chiptune-style tracks on any computer without buying FL Studio.
description:
LMMS is a music production app built by a community of musicians for other musicians. The project is run in the open on GitHub, and anyone can pitch in with code, sounds or help on the forum.

Play instruments with a MIDI keyboard or straight from your computer keyboard. You can bring in MIDI files and Hydrogen drum projects to keep working on them. Polish a mix with the built-in compressor, limiter, delay, reverb, distortion and bass enhancer, shape the tone with graphic and parametric equalizers, and watch the spectrum analyzer as you go. LADSPA effect plugins drop right in. When a track is done, post it on the LMMS Sharing Platform or enter one of the project's competitions.

points.title: A full beat studio for free
points.text: LMMS has a song editor, a piano roll and a Beat+Bassline editor, and it is free and open source under the GPL. It covers sequencing, mixing and automation in one window.

points.title: Sounds out of the box
points.text: It bundles 16 synthesizers, including emulations of the TB-303, the Commodore 64 SID chip, NES and Game Boy sound, plus ZynAddSubFX. SF2, GIG and GUS sample formats load natively.

points.title: VST is Windows and Linux only
points.text: VST instruments and effects work on Windows and Linux, with a bridge for 32-bit plugins on 64-bit Windows. VST plugins do not work on macOS, which limits Mac users to the built-in sounds and other formats.

points.title: Stable release dates from 2020
points.text: The stable version is 1.2.2, released in June 2020. A 1.3.0 alpha exists with newer requirements, but projects saved in it cannot be opened in older LMMS versions.

points.title: Known rough edges
points.text: The download page warns that on some Windows systems LMMS may fail to start or give no sound or distorted sound. Homebrew disabled its LMMS cask in September 2026 because the Mac app failed Apple's Gatekeeper check.

points.title: Versions kept here
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 5 versions, in 32-bit and 64-bit machine-wide installers. macOS (one universal .dmg) and Linux list only the current release. The Flatpak is not marked verified on Flathub.
